metadata.description: Nine free hosted MCP servers for federal contracting data, one plugin each. No account or API key.

plugins.name: sam-gov
plugins.description: Search SAM.gov contract opportunities, entity registrations, SBA certifications and exclusions. Free, hosted, no API key.

plugins.name: usaspending
plugins.description: Look up past federal awards: contracts, grants, recipients, agencies and subawards. Free, hosted, no API key.

plugins.name: ecfr
plugins.description: Read FAR, DFARS and agency supplement text, definitions, and what changed and when. Free, hosted, no API key.

plugins.name: gsa-calc
plugins.description: GSA CALC+ awarded labor ceiling rates for pricing proposals and IGCEs. Free, hosted, no API key.

plugins.name: bls-oews
plugins.description: BLS market wages by occupation and location for pricing proposals and IGCEs. Free, hosted, no API key.

plugins.name: gsa-per-diem
plugins.description: GSA per diem lodging and M&IE rates by city, state or ZIP for pricing travel. Free, hosted, no API key.

plugins.name: federal-register
plugins.description: Proposed and final rules, notices, comment periods and FAR case history. Free, hosted, no API key.

plugins.name: regulations-gov
plugins.description: Rulemaking dockets, documents and public comments from Regulations.gov. Free, hosted, no API key.

plugins.name: acquisition-gov
plugins.description: FAR Overhaul model text, posted agency deviations and guidance from Acquisition.gov. Free, hosted, no API key.
